body: Great learning activities. I am always trying to figure out what me and my child can do together that doesn't include toys, TV or tablet. I used the free version for the longest time and the available actives were enough to keep us learning and interacting. I bought the paid version, which has opened up new learning activities to fill the void of time. Was well worth the purchase. Even if you don't purchase, great app. I would definitely recommend.

I want to update my review! Beyond 5 stars! I've never had such wonderful and fast customer service! They emailed me right away and fixed the problems! ---I have a daycare baby that i watch in my home, and I love the daily activities this app has! But, the app is not saving the progress I have with her. It's frustrating, I put in that she achieved a specific milestone, then when I look later, it's gone. I just paid for the full year and already I'm disappointed

The milestones are interesting and useful but the app does not respond to updates in the milestones. At 4 mths old, my baby was sitting. I updated this milestone but the activities did not update, still showing me exercises to prompt baby to support himself. At 5 months, he was crawling. Again, I updated the milestones, and noted the exercises as "completed" and "too easy", but still more advanced exercises were not offered. I chose not to buy the app since it didn't respond to baby's growth

The app was very useful and helpful when I was able to use it. I learned however, when I got a new phone, that it must have not setup an account for me, or rather, it seems to not use accounts, period. When I opened the app on my new phone there was nowhere to log-on. It was promoting me to start from scratch. So it appears I have lost data I had tracked about my baby and all my notes etc.

Downloaded this to use with and test for my clients' parents. The app won't even open without immediately crashing after reinstalling it multiple times and double-checking device settings and updates, so I definitely can't recommend it to the families I work with since it's unusable for me. On a Google Pixel 8 Pro if that makes any difference.

Was looking forward to using this, the day my baby turned two months, it started crashing. I never even really got to use it, because it is for 2 months and up. Go figure. Looking at the other reviews, I'm definitely not alone. It seems like y'all need to fix the updates.. until then the app is completely useless, as it won't even open.

the tracking is great for knowing when everything last occurred, especially on the overnights. the constant, annoying pop ups and notifications to upgrade to premium are obnoxious. additionally, when they do one of the sample upgrades, there issues no way to shut off the annoying notifications there either and no way to opt out. if they have some control over notifications and pop ups, this would be an easy 5.

Love the ability to track feeds and whatnot free of charge. It's fairly easy and technical issues are few. However, pop-ups to get premium happen multiple times a day. It's super annoying. One time it popped up and I didn't realize it and accidentally hit it with my leg and it tried to charge my debit card $128. Thankfully my bank caught it. I will now be uninstalling it because of this. Do away with the pop-ups! It should not be that easy to accidentally charge your card!!

no widget (android), AI logging does not or rarely work (which would be useful to batch input logs from daycare apps, until better integration exists, if ever), and overall, it doesn't really present data any better than a spreadsheet would. it's somewhat convenient for sharing, but I wouldn't say it has a lot of value.

I've been using this app for nearly a year I want to say. The videos were okay but I especially loved the milestone tracking feature. Lost all of my little ones' progress and milestones because now I can't access anything on the "freemium" experience (what a joke) after the update. Too expensive for me... Deleting now.

Edit: it got worse. Tracking milestones used to be free but i now part of a subscription only service. Even clicking on a milestone to see more detail on what is considered "met" is for subscription only! An okay app, but as of a few weeks ago, there is a 7-day trial pop up EVERY time you open the app, and there is no exit! You're forced into the subscription page and have to find the decline link. Quite preying on people that wont read through the page carefully. It's disgusting.

.05% is actually free.. or of value ... everything else has to be "unlocked".. why dont they offer great information for parents at no cost and earn income with paid advertisements like every other amazing app! Update: They replied and suggested the free version which is what I have been trying out. Its frustrating seeing great content available but having to subscribe for it just isnt what I'm looking for....weekly free content is a little slow. I think they can do much better really

2-3/5 stars. It was great during the free trial, so I bought it. Then suddenly the AI stopped with accurate predictions and it was rendered useless. I like the UI, very sleep in comparison to other apps. But I should have stuck with huckleberry. I appreciate how the app doesn't send you an abundance of notifications/promos if you turn them off (like huckleberry). Lastly, their sleep courses are basic and limited

Decent app during the 7 day free trial. As soon as that finishes, the free app isn't as good at the guessing nap times, making you pay their fee. If it had all the features of my current free baby tracker app I use, I'd potentially think about moving over to the premium. (features like tracking bath time, and other activities like this)

I only have three things to complain about. You don't have the ability to enter formula fed in half ounces, so you are either rounding up or down for how much you are feeding. You also can't differentiate between bottle feeding formula and pumped milk. When I try to log my breast feeding it doesn't allow me to select which side so I have to time it and then enter after the fact. Other than that, this app is great!

Incredible app with so much helpful information for what milestones your baby will be hitting as they get bigger and bigger. Every suggested activity comes with a video and explanation of its significance, and it's so easy to track what your baby has done. I've tried out a few other apps, some slicker and "prettier," but none have the functionally of this one, and they charge a whole bunch of fees. This is, hands down, the best, and I've already recommended it to several people.

Great for tracking milestones! I have used other apps for this, but I like that this one is more reliable as it is from a trusted source and is grounded in actual research. The videos help to know what to look for. The app offers developmentally appropriate activity suggestions to try with your baby which makes it easy to jump right in and begin working on a new skill set. You can also look ahead and see what milestones and abilities will come up next for your little one as they get older.

pretty good. I love all the game suggestions. which it had a few more capabilities. for example, we can track tummy time, but not massage+ 30 10 5, yet the app regularly suggests it. Everyday it has r game suggestions, which you can track when you've completed them,.but you can't track other games that aren't in the suggested four. so lacking there a bit. but the information and play time suggestions are well worth it. and we've been seeing benefits from doing massage+ 30 10 5.

Content is great but app functionality is poor. I'm not thrilled with that for the cost paid. Searching and button selection is very delayed, editing a day is confusing, and the food list to select from in the tracker is weird. It should just list your recent foods instead of random things we will never eat. It seems to try to do that then glitches and resets to random, odd foods.

Good while it lasted, but after a few months it started telling me I only have a few free food searches left. I didn't know when I downloaded the app that it would only allow so many free searches. The information on this app was very useful, but I am not able to spend that much on an app subscription. I understand apps need to earn money somehow, but it's frustrating looking for basic guidance for how to feed my child and everywhere I look just being another money grab on well-meaning parents.

The app is beautiful, but extremely limited by a pay wall. I understand the need to have proper funding to support something this extensive, but it's frustrating that you have to make an account to even access the sliver of content that is available for free. It seems like some kind of simplified features could be made available, such a basic calendar tracking. Otherwise, don't require an account to access what little content is free. That's a shady way to collect email addresses.
